description: CI affected target policy. A project under targets.<target>.knownUnstableProjects runs that target as a warning instead of a gate on the affected lane. Every entry is tracked debt and carries {owner, reason, expires_on, finding_id} — the shape tests/invariants/invariant-reachability.dormant.json uses; scripts/ci/write-affected-target-report.mjs refuses the file when an entry is malformed or expired, and tests/invariants/affected-target-quarantine-ssot.spec.ts ratchets the test quarantine downward.
